source: Super Grok burn trace + burn alerts (Grok Bot)
summary: About 41 points of Super Grok were used between the 10:31 PT reset and 19:05 PT. All of it came from 3 Hermes grok-4.7 TUI sessions: 324 calls, 62.9M tokens, 48% of calls with prompts over 200K. Top spender: 20261008_153835_360010 'Manage anycubic printer files' (3d worktree), 205 calls, 45.0M tokens, ~27-30 points. The big contexts came from the 500K window plus compression.threshold 0.95, which only compresses at ~471K. The token estimate now weights prompts over 200K at 1.3x and reads 41.3% vs the 41% meter. Burn alerts (more than 15 points per PT day, or more than 10 points ahead of pace after noon) now notify-send, show a banner on /ai/usage and add an inbox line. They would have fired at about 16:30 PT today.

proposals.title: Super Grok burn alerts: >15 points per PT day or >10 points ahead after noon -> notify-send + /ai/usage banner + eval inbox line
proposals.rationale: Oct 8: 41 points burned with no warning. pacing() now returns day_rise_pct (from the later of PT midnight and the cycle start) and alerts. day_rise is critical above day_rise_pts (15). noon_ahead fires at or after noon_hour (12) when used minus straight-line expected exceeds noon_ahead_pts (10). Both are configurable in data/supergrok_pacing.json {"alerts":{"day_rise_pts":15,"noon_ahead_pts":10,"noon_hour":12,"renotify_pts":10}}. Cron every 10 min runs supergrok_pacing.pl --alert. It notifies once per kind per day (again after +10 points) with notify-send (DISPLAY :0 + user D-Bus), falls back to log only, and always writes data/supergrok_alerts.log, data/supergrok_alert_notice.txt and today's data/ai_eval_inbox/<date>-supergrok-pacing.json with an ALERT summary line. A stale meter (more than 24 h) still asks for a manual reading once a day. It never switches models and doesn't touch the guards. 65 tests pass. Fired for real at 19:08 PT.

proposals.title: Estimator: weight prompts >= 200K tokens at 1.3x (Super Grok long-context)
proposals.rationale: xAI bills prompts of 200K+ at 2x. A sweep of the long-context weight over 8 reading intervals: CV 0.09 (1.0), 0.07 (1.2), 0.06 (1.3/1.4), 0.07 (1.5). At 1.3, the 10:31-19:05 burn estimates 41.1-41.3% vs the 41% meter; flat weighting gives 37.3%. Rate is now 0.551 %/M weighted tokens.

proposals.title: Seed Super Grok reading 41% at Thu Oct 8 19:04 PT
proposals.rationale: Shanta's meter reading via the AI usage monitor. The live estimate just before seeding was 41.3%, so they agree.

proposals.title: Hermes: compress grok-4.x context below 200K (compression.model_thresholds grok-4: 0.38)
proposals.rationale: The real burn driver. compression.threshold 0.95 x the 500K grok-4.7 window = 471K, so TUI prompts grew to 250-588K (153 of today's 324 calls were over 200K, 40M of 62.9M tokens), each billed at long-context weight. grok-build's 256K window used to cap this at ~243K. Hermes supports per-model thresholds (agent/context_compressor.py resolve_model_threshold). 0.38 x 500K = 190K keeps every call under the 200K tier. Estimated saving: roughly a third of today's burn for the same work. Trade-off: more frequent summaries in long sessions. Not applied; needs Shanta's OK.
